proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's rules effect is a durable adhesive bond between two objects; no existing effect atom creates that state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects.

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.object_pair
proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanic targets a pair of objects as one bonded unit, which cannot be represented with the current single-object attachment shape.

proposed_widenings.name: bond_break_exceptions
proposed_widenings.justification: The created bond persists until a closed list of named counters breaks it; current effects do not encode that removal grammar.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of Universal Solvent or Oil of Etherealness, or with a Wish spell.

notes: No content file was authored. Magic item kind/family exists, but the core mechanic needs a new bonded-object effect plus a paired-object attachment shape. Random ounces-on-discovery and 1-foot-square coverage are additional unsupported details.
